## Activity

During February 2021, the team at Hill Counties Health Centre completed 27 captures as part of routine site activity. The recorded activity provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes for the month. The capture total should be considered alongside the number of images that could not be assessed and the results that were graded referable.

## Image quality

Of the 27 captures, 4 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 14.8 per cent. The result should be monitored through routine operational review, particularly where image quality problems recur. Camera issues should be logged with the service desk so that they can be reviewed and addressed through the appropriate support process. Consistent recording will assist with identifying any continuing equipment or image-capture concerns at Hill Counties Health Centre.

## Grading

A total of 9 results were graded referable. The median grading wait was 1 day. This provides an indication of the time taken for results to progress through grading during February 2021. Activity, image quality and grading outcomes should continue to be reviewed together to support local follow-up and service monitoring.
